IPA(key): /ˈsɛl(ə)/ celle (plural celles or cellen) cell (dependent monastery) cell (residence of a monk or hermit). A private place, room, or building for habitation. A chamber or section, especially one of the brain's parts. (figuratively) A place of entrapment or confinement. (rare) A storeroom.
